name: Again at your doorstep
source:
The protagonist, Ira, decides to send a message to his childhood friends asking if they’d like to spend Christmas together. To his surprise, they accept!

 …A lot of things have changed in the past ten years, but here's hoping that the threads of their connection haven’t snapped just yet. 

[Edited from [url=https://rafaanimations.itch.io/again-at-your-doorstep]itch.io[/url]]
